limitations: Scene candidates use FFmpeg scene score on 270x270 frames. Lighting flashes, action and transitions can trigger changes; gradual or visually similar cuts can be missed.
Intervals are between detector candidates, not manually verified shot durations.
Loudness and silence are measured on the full mix; music can mask speech pauses. No speaker-isolated measurement or subjective listening was performed.
